Areas.Name: Coca-Cola Private Box
Areas.DescriptionHtml:
Upgrade to your own Coca-Cola Private Box at IMAX Sydney

Your experience will include

  • Reserved seating in the IMAX Sydney Bar before the movie
  • Elevated back section of the cinema for up to 4 guests
  • Our biggest luxury leather recliners
  • A choice of beverage per guest, from our Bar
  • Self-serve unlimited classic salted popcorn 
  • Self-serve from the Coca-Cola minibar

Before you arrive, you can also pre-purchase from our Coca-Cola Private Box chef-curated menu to enjoy during your movie.

Sit back, relax, and let us show you the ultimate IMAX experience.

Areas.Name: Full Recliner
Areas.ExperienceHtml:
A luxurious reclining seat for the ultimate relaxation, in premium locations

 

Fully relax and immerse yourself in the movie from the comfort of a Full Recliner. Featuring fully reclining seats with dual controls for your back and legs that allow you to choose your own level of comfort, located in a premium position at the rear of the cinema.

Areas.Name: Couples Seat
Areas.DescriptionHtml:
Elevate your date night experience in our Couples Seat


Perfect for pairs, the double seating option provides a cozy and intimate setting for couples and friends, complete with motorised back recline.

Areas.Name: Standard
Areas.ExperienceHtml:
Our biggest fixed-back cinema seat with leather look and feel

 

No matter which seat you have at IMAX Sydney, every seat is designed for your viewing comfort, and expertly positioned to allow you to fully immerse in the experience. Sit back, look up and take it all in.
